search_intent: How an international buyer should choose between a new, unused-stock or used electric vehicle exported from China
editorial_angle: A heat, title-history and destination-approval framework for Middle Eastern buyers comparing new, unused stock and used Chinese EVs.

sources.title: Global EV Outlook 2026 - Trends in electric cars
sources.supports: Current regional differences in vehicle adoption, charging and operating conditions; regional growth does not establish eligibility for a particular route.

evidence_gaps: Import, approval, tax, registration and operating rules require a dated check for the final Middle Eastern registration state; a regional example is not a legal conclusion.
Legal new-or-used status, battery condition, ownership history, software transfer and warranty eligibility remain VIN-specific and cannot be inferred from mileage.
No unverified price, inventory, configuration, warranty, charging coverage or repair capability is treated as fact; unknown items remain explicit decision gaps.
Every approval must retain the issuer, document version, access date, exact VIN or variant, accountable party and a stop rule if evidence conflicts.

editorial.purpose: Help international vehicle buyers make safer, evidence-led sourcing decisions.

evidence.note: Documented public and primary sources only; no first-hand inspection, transaction, ownership or price claim is made.
